rawContent: Thank you to my friend and colleague @nakedvix for agreeing to share this piece of mine about #MeToo #mentalhealth and #journalism for #IDEVAW2021 #WhiteRibbonDay

For #IDEVAW2021, I wrote about my experience of sexual assault, the shame and stigma I experienced and how I’m sharing my story and working with #journalism colleagues to support them and their #mentalhealth - thanks to @nakedvix and @IndyVoices https://t.co/l0dpjqRG3i #MeToo

‘I know I’m not alone in experiencing the shame and stigma of sexual assault, or in being judged for what I did or didn’t do’ - my latest piece for @IndyVoices on #metoo, #mentalhealth and #journalism and why I’m sharing my story https://t.co/aNQsgRpU5y with thanks to @nakedvix
